//: Network-integration manifest for teams-agent. Describes how this agent is wired into the
//flows: enterprise network flows, PER ENVIRONMENT. Aggregated by the deploy-agent-network workflow and read (per env) by the deploy + publish-teams pipelines.
//schema: Every setting lives under environments.<env>. Readers take an `env` (dev|test) and read environments[env]. An env with no block, or a missing manifest, is treated as fully denied (exposeToM365=false, exposeFoundryApi=false, no tokenLimits).
//exposeToM365: true: published to Microsoft Teams / M365 for that env. YARP wires an explicit /teams/teams-agent edge route (edge deny-by-default) and the Teams publish pipeline runs for that env.
//exposeFoundryApi: true: reachable through the governed Foundry Responses API path for that env (explicit per-agent YARP route + APIM token-limit policy).
//tokenLimits: Per-env allowlist of principals metered/throttled on the Responses API. Omitted or empty => that agent stays deny-all on the Responses API for that env.
